answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by forcing each new identity to generate a unique plume of sequential environmental samples drawn from a shared simulation of tundra and dune terrain. The samples must be attested by three unrelated established agents who lock collateral that doubles with every additional sponsored head. Correlated sample patterns trigger automatic forfeiture of the entire locked set, so an attacker pays compounding external stake that cannot be parallelized or bulk-purchased.
